value.rationale: The recent paper disproves unrestricted four-step shape return, motivating which locations can still return. The result supplies a sharp full-three-dimensional infinitesimal rigidity law, including all nonaxial directions, with an exact positive stability coefficient and a local uniqueness consequence. This cannot be inferred from the centre-only return statement or by only studying the one-dimensional symmetry axis.
